kjv: no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre
mine: not violent … not a lover of money
note: TR adds "me aischrokerde" (from Titus 1:7); absent from Sinaiticus, A, D, F, G.

kjv: Even so [must their (the deacons')] wives [be] grave
note: gynaikas in a list of deacons' qualifications may be deacons' wives or women deacons (cf. Phoebe, Rom 16:1); the KJV supplies "their" (in italics) and decides the question.

kjv: God was manifest in the flesh
mine: He (Christ) was manifested in the flesh
note: TR "theos" (ΘΣ) against "hos" (ΟΣ, "who/he who") in Sinaiticus*, A*, C*, F, G; the two differ by a stroke in uncial script. "Hos" begins a hymn about Christ; "God" makes the verse a direct statement of the incarnation of God, long cited for that doctrine.
